scope: Twelve deliberately selected church/source screens, separate from the 86-identity catalogue. Three additional leads are shown separately. These are metadata observations, not acquired texts or a representative national sample.

screens.name: Heritage Baptist Church
screens.tradition: Baptist (platform category; formal denominational affiliation not established)
screens.speaker_evidence: Scott Hanks is named on the broadcaster profile and the two inspected sermon examples; the archive also contains other speakers.
coverage: Transcript displays were previously observed for January 26, 2022 and June 21, 2026.
September and October 2026 each show records on all four Sundays. October 2022 and 2025 coverage is not established.
limits: The earlier item is midweek and the later item is Sunday evening; they are not matched event types.
Transcript export, provenance and reuse rights still need validation.
screens.next_action: Validate the broadcaster’s permitted transcript export route and the requested 2022/2025 date windows before collecting text.

screens.name: Woodruff Road Presbyterian Church
screens.speaker_evidence: Carl Robbins is named on the broadcaster profile and the inspected examples. Guest speakers also appear in recent archives.
coverage: Inspected examples date to January 9, 2022 and August 16, 2026.
One Samuel series lists all five August 2021 Sundays. October 2022 and 2025 coverage is not established.
limits: One series does not establish complete church coverage. The example service types differ.
Transcript export and reuse rights have not been validated.
screens.next_action: Validate permitted transcript export and archive pagination, then check the same date windows and event types.

screens.name: Trinity Baptist Church
screens.tradition: Reformed Baptist (platform category; formal affiliation not established)
screens.speaker_evidence: David Chanski is named on the profile, inspected examples and the Romans-series observations.
coverage: Earlier observations found Romans-series entries on all four August 2022 and all five August 2025 Sundays.
The older series page was unavailable on recheck. October 2025 has one observed series date, October 19; the October 2022 window remains unknown.
limits: The series is not an inventory of all church sermons.
Earlier metadata remains evidence, but the older page was not reproduced in the latest check.
screens.next_action: Resolve the permitted historical archive/export route before relying on a same-speaker panel.

source_links.label: Older series page — latest check unavailable

screens.name: St Mark’s Episcopal Church
screens.speaker_evidence: St Mark’s identifies Adam Thomas as rector and links his author archive. Manuscript authorship does not independently establish each event’s venue.
coverage: The author index contains 43 entries for 2022 and 45 for 2025.
Nine October observations cover five 2022 Sunday dates and four 2025 dates. Eight exact pages were readable in the latest check; one failed after an earlier successful observation.
limits: Author archive, not a complete record of services at St Mark’s.
Three same-liturgical-label pairs include only one pair with equal header passages. No AI-use evidence follows.
screens.next_action: Use the dated author metadata to define the intended analysis, then apply the CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 conditions to the specific copying and processing operations.

screens.name: Memorial Congregational Church
screens.speaker_evidence: The church identifies Allen Vander Meulen as a streaming worship producer who preaches occasionally. The two manuscripts name their author and claim delivery at Memorial.
coverage: Manuscript labels state delivery on May 29, 2022 and October 26, 2025.
These are two occasional-preacher examples, not an established weekly series.
limits: The stated delivery labels were not independently checked against recordings.
The identified CC BY-NC 4.0 notice does not cover every church publication or recording.
screens.next_action: Treat the specifically licensed 2022 work and the separate 2025 manuscript individually; establish each item’s applicable rights and do not infer weekly coverage.

screens.name: Fourth Presbyterian Church
screens.speaker_evidence: The church archive names multiple speakers. Four same-written-name groups form the selected target checks: Joseph L. Morrow, Matt Helms, Nanette Sawyer and Rocky Supinger.
coverage: 107 annual index records: 55 for 2022 and 52 for 2025.
33 selected targets are included in those 107: 32 rendered manuscript bodies, 28 without an inspected conflict, four discrepancies and one unavailable page.
limits: No inspected conflict does not establish complete delivery or text reuse rights.
All 2025 target service times remain unconfirmed. The annual index also contains two explicit no-sermon services and a grouped youth entry.
screens.next_action: Resolve the four source discrepancies and intended-use rights; retain separate indexed and target-header values before choosing a dated text panel.

screens.name: Haller Lake United Methodist Church
screens.tradition: United Methodist Church (site name; formal affiliation not independently checked)
screens.speaker_evidence: No supported item-level speaker identity was established in this screen.
coverage: The page labels several historical 2022 entries as manuscripts and has current dated media links.
The inspected historical links were represented by one repeated Facebook destination; individual text targets remain unverified.
limits: A manuscript label is not evidence that the linked body is available.
No continuous 2022/2025 text window or reuse grant was established.
screens.next_action: Establish the actual historical destinations and text availability through a permitted route before selecting items.

screens.name: St Louis Catholic Church
screens.speaker_evidence: No supported item-level speaker identity was established in this screen.
coverage: The inspected homily page exposes sparse links from 2023–2025.
A pre-2023 window was not established.
limits: Sparse inspected links do not prove that no other homilies exist.
No continuous pre/post series or reuse grant was established.
screens.next_action: Locate a permitted historical archive and identify speakers and dates before selecting a continuous panel.

screens.name: Blessed Trinity Catholic Community
screens.speaker_evidence: Official staff names Fr. Ed Hislop as pastor; the three previously observed PDF headers name him. The community and its mission share an archive.
coverage: Three earlier PDF observations state October 2, 2022, October 12, 2025 and October 26, 2025.
On later checks both 2025 PDFs returned 404 and the 2022 PDF was inaccessible.
limits: Preserve the earlier observations, but do not call the files currently accessible.
Shared community/mission headers do not resolve delivery venue. One archive must not become two corpora.
screens.next_action: Resolve current access through an authorized route and establish reuse terms; retain the historical evidence and venue uncertainty.
